children.title: Add capitalize function
children.brief:
Goal: Add a `capitalize(s)` function to strings.js that capitalizes the first letter of a string, and write a unit test for it.

Context: The project has strings.js and a test suite. Add the function to the exports and create tests that verify correct capitalization behavior.

Constraints: Only touch strings.js and its test file. No other changes.

Done when: capitalize function is exported from strings.js, has at least one unit test, and the test suite passes.

risks: Only the first character is uppercased; the rest of the string is left as-is ("hELLO" becomes "HELLO", not "Hello"). Lowercasing the remainder would be a different behavior.
First character is split by code point, so astral-plane characters are handled, but locale-specific case rules (e.g. Turkish dotted i) are not special-cased.
